4078430.desc: 《星際大戰：銀河賽車手™》是一款以連場賽事為核心、刺激高風險的賽車體驗，故事發生在無法無天的邊境星域。隨著帝國覆滅、銀河系重建，銀河聯盟應運而生：這裡是一個地下、未經官方認可的賽車聯盟，各大犯罪集團在此資助混亂，鍛造新世代冠軍。

1874880.name: Arma Reforger
1874880.review_detail: 53,227 篇使用者評論中有 80% 給予此遊戲好評。
1874880.desc: 投身大規模聯合作戰，即時創建和策劃戰鬥任務，運用無限的社群模組，自由打造屬於你的遊戲體驗。登上冷戰前線，體驗史上最真實、最具沉浸感的軍事沙盒遊戲。

2868840.name: Slay the Spire 2
2868840.review_detail: 3,343 篇使用者評論中有 47% 給予此遊戲好評。
2868840.desc: 經典 Roguelike 牌組構築遊戲回歸！在《殺戮尖塔 2》中打造獨一無二的牌組、遭遇奇異生物，並發掘蘊含強大力量的遺物！

5449750.name: 終末街区
5449750.desc: 在殭屍橫行的城市蒐集物資，與夥伴守護家園的生存動作RPG。探索街區、即時戰鬥、製作道具、耕作、防守據點與回收車輛，在崩壞的日常中求生。決定何時繼續前進，何時帶大家平安回家。

4907430.name: GrindFall
4907430.desc: A thrilling Co-op Action Roguelite for 1-4 players! Play as mischievous ghosts, create insane weapon synergies, catch humans, and turn them into pumpkins. Deliver your harvest to the crypt, expand the map, and unleash vibrant chaos in this Bullet Heaven!

5340660.name: オーダーバーガー
5340660.desc: [Overview]"Order's Burger" is a fast-paced action game where you stack ingredients to match incoming orders. [Key Features]Fast-paced ingredient stacking Increasing difficulty levels Time attack & high score rankings Test your reflexes and become the ultimate burger master!

5271040.name: Junkyard Reseller
5271040.desc: Explore junkyards, find rusty figurines and collectibles, and restore them with a laser. The better you restore an item, the more it sells for. Deliver orders to villagers and grow your resale business.

5383270.name: Soul Snake 3D
5383270.desc: Slither through seven cursed biomes as a snake that grows into a weapon. Eat prey, auto-fire venom darts, and build a run from 68 upgrade cards and 9 evolutions. Topple each biome's guardian, bank souls for permanent upgrades, and see how long you last in endless Survival.

5094470.name: BONEYARD BOUNCE!
5094470.desc: 從四邊的擋板射出魔彈，把從墓園湧出的怪物一掃而空！由打磚塊進化而來的怪物射擊遊戲。用弱點屬性擊殺，爆炸會無視牆壁一路連鎖，把整群怪物一口氣炸飛。隨便亂射也很好玩，還有計分挑戰與計時挑戰。制霸全部7座墓地吧。被放跑的怪物會流進其他墓地，讓那裡變得更強。要往哪裡走，由你決定。

5352690.name: Bust Out
5352690.desc: Bust Out is a chaotic co-op casino sandbox for 1 to 8 friends. Gamble at real tables, party at the bar, brawl with security and if you dare, sneak past the guards and clean out the vault. No timers, no pressure: every decision is a bet.

3266730.name: No Alibi
3266730.desc: Rob banks, collect bounties, and gamble it all away in No Alibi. Up to 4 players work together to lead their criminal empire to success. Use your customized guns and equipment to take hostages and steal everything you can. Just make sure the boss gets paid.
